title: Expressions & Meta-Arguments
summary: The expression language (templates, conditionals, for expressions, splats, key functions) and the meta-arguments that shape resources: count, for_each, dynamic blocks, depends_on, lifecycle rules, pre/postconditions, check blocks and provider aliases.
objectives: Write string templates, heredocs, conditionals, for expressions and splat expressions fluently
Use the core built-in functions (try, can, lookup, merge, coalesce, flatten, setproduct, cidrsubnet, jsonencode, templatefile, file)
Choose between count and for_each and explain the index-shift problem
Generate repeated nested blocks with dynamic blocks without overusing them
Apply lifecycle rules (create_before_destroy, prevent_destroy, ignore_changes, replace_triggered_by) and pre/postconditions
Add continuous validation with check blocks and target multiple configurations of a provider with aliases
